description:
Convert simple YAML (maps, lists, scalars, flow {} / []) to JSON. Anchors, tags, and complex block scalars are not supported.

Returns: Pretty-printed JSON built from the YAML input.
Example input: {"yaml":"name: Ada\nskills:\n  - math\n  - logic"}
On error, includes hint: Pass the YAML document as `yaml`; only 2-space indented block YAML is supported.
name: yaml_to_json
title: YAML to JSON
